chain.title: A Model Waiting for a Subject
chain.desc: Craft a Model Framework. Choose a creature that this pack supports before approaching it; not every entity has a data model.

chain.title: Carry Your Field Laboratory
chain.desc: The Deep Learner holds the models you are training. Keep it with you during the matching encounters and inspect the model information before a hunt.

chain.title: Record Your First Specimen
chain.desc: Use the Model Framework on a supported creature to make its data model. If this pack disables attunement, follow its model recipe instead. Confirm once you have a real model.

chain.title: A Model Ready for Simulation
chain.desc: Place the model in your Deep Learner and defeat matching creatures yourself. Watch its progress until it reaches Basic or better; a Faulty model cannot run simulations. Confirm after the tier changes.

chain.title: A Supply of Blank Predictions
chain.desc: Craft Prediction Matrices for the Simulation Chamber. Set aside a supply for repeated cycles rather than treating the first matrix as the finished production line.

chain.title: A Battlefield in a Box
chain.desc: Build a Simulation Chamber and connect an energy supply. Its energy demand depends on the selected model, so inspect the displayed cost before choosing your generator.

chain.title: Run the First Simulation
chain.desc: Insert your Basic-or-better model and Prediction Matrices into the powered chamber. Keep the output slots clear and wait for a completed cycle, then confirm this milestone.

chain.title: Turn Predictions into Supplies
chain.desc: Build a Loot Fabricator and connect energy. It turns a creature-specific prediction into a selected supported reward; a generalized dimension prediction is a different material.

chain.title: Choose What the Factory Makes
chain.desc: Run enough simulations to obtain a creature-specific prediction. Put it in the Loot Fabricator, choose an available output and collect the result. Confirm after producing the resource you chose.

chain.title: A Reliable Loot Supply
chain.desc: Arrange matrix input, energy delivery and output collection so the chamber and fabricator can repeat without blocked slots. Confirm after several successful cycles with your chosen model.

chain.title: Know the Enemy
chain.desc: Continue developing a supported model until its displayed tier reaches Self Aware. Follow the model progress shown by this pack; this milestone confirms the tier manually.

chain.title: A Network That Pays Off
chain.desc: Run a stable loot line with an advanced model and stocked matrices. Keep room for both simulation outputs and choose a resource your other projects need. Confirm when the line is working.

notes: Original operational guidance verified against local item models, recipes and English tooltips. No pack-authored prose copied.
